name: Speka
description: An OpenAI-compatible model gateway with a small recurring allowance.
overview: Speka advertises $1 of model usage monthly on its $0 free plan, no card, with 10 requests per minute and one key. Its docs say exhausted allowance returns 402, while pricing also describes paid overages; verify account billing controls. Live model catalogue changes and identity, balance and inference were not independently tested.
free_access: Pricing mentions billed overages; docs describe 402 on exhaustion
notes: Base URL https://speka.me/v1. Check actual prices and billing controls before use.
